questions.questionText: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has exactly 6 faces, all of which are squares.

questions.questionText: What is the surface area of a cube with side length 3?
What is the volume of a cube with side length 4?
How many edges does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has 12 edges: 4 on top, 4 on bottom, and 4 vertical.

questions.questionText: If a cube has side length s, which formula gives its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube = side × side × side = s³
